newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL noon rubber down on ringgit, trade to Abu Dhabi.
newsitem.headline: KL noon rubber down on ringgit, trade to Abu Dhabi.

text.p: Rubber prices in Malaysia were quoted lower at noon on the strength of the ringgit against the U.S. dollar, dealers said.
They said there was no sign of fresh buying although government trade sources reported a sale on Friday of 1,500 tonnes of August SMR20 to Abu Dhabi at 247.50 cents a kg.
"The ringgit is the factor for the (price) adjustment," said a trader. "Otherwise, it's a quiet start to the week."
At midday, the Malaysian Rubber Exchange and Licensing Board quoted the RSS1 for September buyer at 249.50 cents a kg, down one cent from Friday.
The SMR20 was also at 249.50, after dipping half cent.
Dealers offered SMR CV at 293 cents, SMR L at 275, SMR 5 at 253, SMR 10 at 247 and SMR 20 at 245 and latex at 190.
Malaysia-based shipping brokers quoted freight rates for rubber from Malaysia to Rotterdam at $700 per 20-ft container, and $1,400 per 40-ft container.
